- Docs anchors to preserve if any delta exists:

- No new public interface should be added beyond the existing `WORKFLOW_PROFILE` operator surface.
- Preserve fail-fast behavior for unknown profiles.
- Preserve non-destructive downgrade semantics: out-of-profile wrappers already present in consumer repos stay in place.
- Do not touch consumer repos or `.github/ai/consumer_repos.json`.

- Biggest risk is false-positive work: the branch already looks complete, so unnecessary edits would be regression-prone churn.
- `full.txt` must stay synchronized with all top-level `workflow-templates/*.yml` wrappers, including `ai-update-workflows.yml` even though the updater skips overwriting itself.
- Do not introduce `rm`, `git rm`, or local workflow directory sweep logic.
- If docs need any touch-up, keep edits append-only under the existing anchors and avoid unrelated README reflow.

- Primary contract test: `python3 tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py` (already passes on this ref).

  - no accidental changes outside this repository scope
